parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Bank-road (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 640 | 5.21 | 5.21
2 | 934 | 8.58 | 13.8
3 | 2594 | 84.1 | 97.9
4 | 4386 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as AK-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Bank-road (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: AK-type
Aquifer depth: 13.8 – 97.9 m
Recommendation: Drill to a depth between 60 m and 80 m to harness the prolific saturated sands within Layer 3, ensuring borehole termination before reaching the high-resistivity basement/bedrock layer at 97.9 m. Well screens should be positioned across the most permeable intervals within this target aquifer zone.
